sample_description: Pyrenophora teres f. teres is the cause of barley net form of net blotch. A reference genome assembly for Pyrenophora teres f. teres strain W1 was produced based on Pacific Biosciences long read sequencing chemistry at > 100’s coverage. Whole chromosomes were constructed by optical mapping to join assembly breaks caused by extensive repetitive DNA with genetic mapping used as a second means of validation. Gene predictions were guided by RNAseq.
